recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast macro shot of a sunflower head filling the lower two-thirds of the frame, set against a clear blue sky where a small red vintage biplane flies in the upper left. The composition is anchored by centered, elegant serif typography that spans the width of the flower petals.
coreVisualRelationships: The vibrant yellow petals radiate outward from a dark, textured seed center at the bottom edge.
The small red biplane provides a narrative focal point against the vast blue negative space of the sky.
The white typography is layered directly over the mid-section of the sunflower petals for high legibility.
The horizontal line separating text blocks mimics a horizon line within the floral landscape.
coreInvariants: Primary color palette of yellow, blue, and red

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The sunflower is the dominant subject, scaled to fill the entire width and bottom half of the frame. The biplane is a secondary, small-scale element in the upper left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, circular seed head at the bottom center acts as the structural anchor for the radiating petals.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the dark center, follows the petals upward to the central text, and then moves to the small red plane in the sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image is clear blue sky, providing breathing room for the dense floral texture below.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Azure blue (sky) and dark brown/black (seed head)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all primary hues with high value contrast between the white text and yellow petals.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended horizontal bar used as a divider between text lines

typesetting.lineBreakPattern: Two main lines separated by a rule

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Classical serif for the main title paired with a geometric, wide-tracked sans-serif for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary classical elegance and sharp serifs.
Suitable for the top metadata line with high tracking.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a macro photograph of a vibrant yellow sunflower filling the bottom 70% of the frame, showing the dark textured center at the very bottom. The background is a clear, solid blue sky. In the upper left corner, place a small, detailed red vintage biplane flying horizontally.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of wide-tracked white sans-serif text at the top edge. In the center of the sunflower petals, add two lines of large white serif text in all caps, separated by a thin white horizontal line that extends nearly to the edges of the text block.

verificationChecks: Is the sunflower the dominant visual element?
Is the red biplane small and placed in the sky area?
Is the main text centered and legible against the yellow petals?
Is the color palette strictly yellow, blue, red, and white?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the horizontal divider line
mustRedesign: Specific movie titles or brand names
postGenerationChecks: Check that the red plane is not too large or distracting.
Ensure the white text has enough contrast against the yellow petals.
Verify the horizontal line is perfectly level.
Confirm the sunflower center is visible at the bottom edge.
recipe.reuseFormula: Macro Floral Subject + Small Narrative Object in Sky + Centered Classical Serif Typography with Horizontal Rule.
